organization.name_ja: トヨタ自動車株式会社・トヨタコネクティッド株式会社
organization.name_en: Toyota Motor Corporation and Toyota Connected Corporation

affected.note: About 120,000 T-Connect application forms (2014-05 to 2021-12) and about 20,000 G-Link forms (2014-07 to 2021-12) that dealers did not forward and that were lost or discarded.

summary.en: Toyota and Toyota Connected said about 140,000 paper application forms for the T-Connect and G-Link connected car services could not be located. The forms, which dealers were supposed to forward, contained names, addresses, contact details, contract IDs and passwords.
summary.ja: トヨタ自動車とトヨタコネクティッドは、コネクティッドサービス「T-Connect」「G-Link」の利用申込書計約14万件の所在が確認できないと公表した。販売店から提出されないまま紛失や破棄された例があり、氏名や住所、契約ID、パスワードなどが記載されていた。
